text: Heather is simply amazing! She did a live wedding painting at our wedding, and has been the talk of the town ever since! I met the beautiful Heather Wolfe at the Pink Bride Show, and received the live wedding painting as a wedding gift from a family member. She incorporated our Model T "going away car", my dogs, and our local homemade ice cream truck into the painting that created an image that I could never have gotten with just a photograph. The details and dimension in the painting are unreal. We just stare at it all the time! Heather was so easy to work with as she truly went above and beyond to capture our vision of our first dance moment. I can't say enough good things about her; she's incredibly talented, beautiful inside and out, and will make your wedding dream come true!

owner_reply.text:
Merry thank you so much for your kind words! I loved working with you just as much! Your wedding was SO BEAUTIFUL and the details...😍
It was such an honor to create the painting YOU envisioned! I hope you enjoy the painting for many years to come! Thank you again for allowing me to be a part of your special day!! -Heather
